## George Washington University — Washington, DC
*May 2013 – Present*

**Senior Software Developer and Librarian**, [GW Libraries](https://library.gwu.edu/)

Developing open-source web applications and infrastructure supporting digital preservation and archiving, web development, catalog integration, and library information technology. Sharing expertise with students, researchers, and faculty by providing consultations and teaching workshops in Python, R, and related topics focused on data skills. Projects include:

- **Open Access Analytics** — Building a data pipeline and executive-level dashboard to track compliance with GW's new Open Access Policy across faculty-authored scholarly publications.
- **[GW ScholarSpace](https://scholarspace.library.gwu.edu/)** — Primary software developer of GWU's institutional open-access scholarship repository, built with [Hyrax](https://hyrax.samvera.org/), Ruby on Rails, and other technologies.
- **[The ISIS Files](https://isisfiles.gwu.edu/)** — Primary software developer for a Hyrax-based public repository of specialized artifacts, in collaboration with the [GW Program on Extremism](https://extremism.gwu.edu/).
- **[Social Feed Manager](https://github.com/gwu-libraries/sfm-ui)** — Software developer of this GWU-built tool that helps researchers build collections of social media data from Twitter and other platforms. Built with Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, APScheduler, RabbitMQ, and other technologies. Worked with numerous researchers in the GWU community to build collections of interest.

**Adjunct Instructor**, [Milken Institute School of Public Health](https://publichealth.gwu.edu/)

Co-creator and co-instructor of a new 1-credit course, *Introduction to R Programming in Public Health and Biomedical Research* (PUBH 6899 / PUBH 6851), offered through the Milken Institute School of Public Health Summer Institute. Delivered online in Summer 2020 and Summer 2021.
